D003.key_difference: Onset of hyperactivity/impulsivity and relationship with manic symptoms

D003: Mood changes may occur but are distinct from a manic episode; hyperactivity/impulsivity appear continuously regardless of this.
D008: Hyperactivity/impulsivity occur exclusively during the course of a manic episode.

D003.key_difference: Onset of hyperactivity/impulsivity and relationship with psychotic symptoms

D003: Psychotic symptoms may co-occur, but hyperactivity/impulsivity appear continuously from before, unrelated to psychotic symptoms.
D005: Hyperactivity/impulsivity are observed starting from the prodromal phase or after the onset of psychotic symptoms.
